headline: Stop gaining, start the deficit NOW
summary: You're at -0.01 kg/week when you need -0.74 kg/week; today's actions compound into weekend discipline and reverse the +0.4kg monthly trend.
details: Eat three Huel meals today—zero snacking, zero emotional eating—and commit to 35 minutes on the rowing machine to build real deficit. This Wednesday is your setup for the Friday-Sunday danger zone; you either enter the weekend with momentum and discipline, or you enter it with failure—momentum wins.
